reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: Escape no longer empties the input; it only closes the list. This is the default the maintainer proposes in #485, and the same change an earlier run made.
caveats: The clear event is no longer emitted on Escape, because nothing is cleared. A consumer that listened for it on Escape would need the option the maintainer describes.
